capabilities.problem: A fixed evidence packet cannot incorporate newly found counterevidence without breaking prior assessment bindings; interrupted actions and missing independent reviews need explicit states.
capabilities.mechanism: Wrap immutable checker snapshots with append-only lineage and action receipts; bind independent initial views, explicit synthesis and seeded excluded-candidate audits. No model runner or semantic endorsement is implied. Prepare packet-bound two-role batches, audit excluded candidates with a saved seed, and preserve incomplete review and bounded follow-up states. Reconstruct an immutable Markdown/HTML proposal package and bind real user-message records and candidate versions to the viewed report; preserve pending choices and return-to-Stage2 conditions.

hard_measures: Retained packet/source/candidate versions, invalidated assessments and exact action input/artifact identities
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent live judges determine whether evidence supports an opportunity or revision.

hard_measures: Missing independent reviews, unresolved disagreements, audit population and seed, pending candidates, distinct action failures and unknown costs
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent evaluation determines whether the dispositions and choice package are scientifically useful.

guardrails: No change to frozen rubric, previous packet or Stage3 authority

capabilities.problem: Free-form research ideas can lose their provenance or be forced into unsupported structured claims; dependent or noncomparable studies can be mistaken for independent agreement.
capabilities.mechanism: Prepare native-capability comparison and open ideation prompts, then validate separate no-tool extraction against saved prose and versioned evidence; preserve earlier candidates when building the next packet. Export a draft Markdown/HTML companion from one validated view, retaining full bibliography and raw prose without granting recommendation or selection.

hard_measures: Exact prose spans, known evidence/source versions, explicit comparability and preserved candidate history
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent judges assess comparison and opportunity quality; structure alone establishes no scientific improvement.
